For me, Julio is the best dog groomer. He's incredibly patient, which is something few groomers have. I've been going to him for two years and I'm always extremely happy and satisfied with his work. I highly recommend him.

I took my dog ​​to this wonderful grooming salon and I was very pleased with the service. They gave him a great bath; he came out clean, smelling wonderful, and his fur looked beautiful. They also trimmed his nails very carefully.

My dog ​​has a heart condition, so it was important to me that he be treated with patience and gentleness, and that's exactly what they did. You can see the care and affection they put into their work. I was very satisfied and will definitely be back.
